name: frontend-feature
title: Frontend Feature Delivery
description: Disciplined frontend workflow with explicit requirement, codebase, design, implementation, quality-fix, and review gates.

planner.description: Clarifies user workflow, UX constraints, local conventions, and acceptance criteria.

executor.description: Implements the scoped UI change and performs required local checks.

reviewer.description: Reviews behavior, visual fit, regression risk, and missing verification.

steps.task: Analyze the requested frontend feature. Output JSON with scope, target users, workflows, acceptance criteria, assumptions, and risks. Stop if the product intent or main workflow is unclear.

Inspect the existing UI architecture, state flow, styling system, routing, tests, and local design conventions. Output JSON with files to touch, reusable components, constraints, and verification plan.
Create a concise implementation plan covering layout, responsive behavior, empty/loading/error states, accessibility, and expected test coverage.
Implement the approved frontend change within the scoped files. Keep unrelated refactors out of scope and record any assumptions as task notes.
Run focused syntax, unit, and UI verification. Fix regressions found by checks. Output JSON with commands, results, screenshots or browser checks when applicable, and residual risk.
Review the diff and verification results. Reply PASS or blockers only, including file-level issues and missing tests.
